does_not_close: No coating-efficacy, product-performance, batch-release, or corrosion-rank authority.

Does not dispute the physical theory (Ridge regression, Hoerl & Kennard 1970) itself, nor the LOSD-CV design as a study-bias control; it disputes whether the KPI's beats-null claim implies any group-transferable predictive value, which is a materially different and stronger claim than in-domain interpolation.
Does not modify or supersede the signed NIST baseline KPI, the prior fold-significance audit, or the raw dataset; all remain independently valid artifacts, referenced by path + sha256.

Phase-1 would need either (a) an explicit, honestly-scoped claim restricted to the five trained material groups only, or (b) features that carry real physicochemical transfer (e.g. standard electrode potential, alloy composition) in place of a bare material-group one-hot, to support any claim of predictive value for novel coatings/substrates.
headline: Leave-one-material-group-out (LOMO-CV) extrapolation audit of the NIST CORR-DATA marine steel baseline KPI's '+0.0475 log10 (7.0%) Ridge-beats-NULL' claim, on the same hash-pinned raw CSV (n=588 records / 30 source documents / 3 environments / 5 material groups, reproduces exactly). Held out each of the 5 material groups in turn (Aluminum, Carbon/alloy steels, Copper, Nickel, Stainless -- corrosion-rate medians spanning nearly 3 orders of magnitude, 0.006-0.10 mm/yr), refitting Ridge on the other four with an extrapolation-honest NULL (training-only median, never touching the held-out group's own labels). Pooled across all 588 held-out predictions: Ridge-LOMO MAE=1.0728 vs NULL-LOMO MAE=0.8106, a NEGATIVE improvement of -0.2622 log10 units (vs the signed in-domain LOSD claim of +0.0475) -- -552% of the claimed in-domain improvement is retained under group-safe extrapolation. Per-group: Ridge beats the extrapolation-honest NULL on only 2/5 held-out groups; the worst case is Carbon and alloy steels, where Ridge MAE exceeds NULL MAE by 0.6587 log10 units (Ridge is WORSE than a naive constant). 3/5 groups show Ridge strictly worse than NULL. This demonstrates the model's in-domain 'beats-null' advantage is substantially or wholly material-group memorization via the one-hot dummy (interpolation among five already-seen categories with very different baseline rate levels), not a transferable physical relationship the environment/temperature/concentration/duration terms encode -- exactly the distinction LOSD-CV, which keeps all five groups present in every training fold, cannot detect. Conclusion: H0 (the beats-null effect reflects group-transferable predictive information, not group-identity memorization) is H0 REFUTED.
prior_audit_relationship: Distinct from evidence/audit/nist-baseline-fold-significance-v1 (which attacked LOSD-fold reproducibility/robustness of the same pooled number and already found H0_REFUTED). This audit does not repeat that test; it holds the LOSD result fixed and instead asks whether the beats-null effect generalizes across a genuinely novel held-out axis (material group) that LOSD-CV never tests, since every material group is present via one-hot dummy in every LOSD training fold.
target_claim: evidence/phase0/kpis/nist-corr-data-marine-steel-corrosion-baseline-kpi.v1.json#fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.improvement_MAE_log10_reduction=0.0475 (Ridge beats per-material-group-median NULL; implicit generalization claim that the environment/temperature/concentration/duration features carry group-transferable predictive information, tested here under group-safe leave-one-material-group-out extrapolation rather than the signed KPI's leave-one-source-document-out interpolation split)

T1_population_filter_reproduction.note: Independent re-derivation from raw CORR-DATA_Database.csv (hash-pinned 9b6b82d0..., matches dataset_fixture_sha256 in the signed KPI). Reproduces exactly n=588/30 docs/3 envs/5 material groups, identical to the prior fold-significance audit.

T2_pooled_lomo_ridge_vs_null.note: NULL here is extrapolation-honest: median(log10 rate) over the FOUR TRAINING material groups only, never the held-out group's own labels (unlike the signed KPI's per-material-group median NULL, which requires having already seen the group). Ridge is refit per held-out group with that group's one-hot column all-zero in training (uninformative, as it would be for a truly novel material category).
T2_pooled_lomo_ridge_vs_null.refute_bar: pooled LOMO improvement (NULL_MAE - Ridge_MAE) >= 0.01 log10 units

T3_per_group_sign_test.refute_bar: Ridge should beat NULL on a majority (>=3/5) of held-out material groups

T4_catastrophic_miscalibration_check.note: signed_bias > 0 means Ridge systematically OVER-predicts corrosion rate for the held-out group (log10 units); < 0 means it under-predicts.
T4_catastrophic_miscalibration_check.refute_bar: Ridge-LOMO MAE should never exceed the extrapolation-honest constant NULL for any held-out group

T5_degradation_vs_signed_in_domain_claim.refute_bar: LOMO pooled improvement retains >= 50% of the signed in-domain (LOSD) +0.0475 log10 improvement
